set.body: Build the resumable JVM, Python, and Julia court runner. Fail closed on dirty or changing sources and an active host; fingerprint commits, dependency locks, runtimes, hardware, threads, and workloads; separate cold startup and compilation from warmed execution; retain raw samples, phase timings, allocations, peak RSS, output checksums, and proof logs.
set.title: Build reproducible cross-language performance court harness
